Outcomes significantly above the 90% confidence interval could be driven by unexpectedly positive economic news, a major technological breakthrough, a sudden and significant increase in demand, or a favorable policy change that was not anticipated. These "black swan" type events, by their very nature, are difficult to predict and thus lie outside the typical distributions assumed in constructing these probabilistic forecasts.
